_comment_2: Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SHA256_FINGERPRINT below, then commit + push.

_comment_5: IMPORTANT: if you enable Play App Signing, Google re-signs your app with ITS OWN key. Add that fingerprint too (see the second entry of sha256_cert_fingerprints below). Find it in Play Console > Setup > App integrity > App signing key certificate.
